scores.rationale: The report provides no concrete fact tied to protecting founder weekends or family time. Its founder-overload mitigation concerns execution capacity, not these personal-time boundaries.
No option-level comparison distinguishes protecting weekends or family time from an always-on founder schedule. Delivery-format comparisons address learner flexibility and operating costs instead.
Protecting weekends or family time is not used to rank, include, exclude or recommend any option, even as a secondary fit factor.

The recommendation does not explicitly endorse an always-on schedule, but it also provides no preference-specific evidence concerning founder weekends or family time. Under the supplied absent-evidence anchor, silence alone does not earn credit.
